  Design Patterns [CSE-4065]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           List the main essential elements of the design pattern using UML diagram.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply Model view controller architecture pattern in case of designing library  
  management software.                                                                      (3)  
  
  C)      Distinguish between creational and structural design patterns using any suitable example  
  with respect to intent, problem, applicability, solution and meta UML model.             (5)  
  
  2)           List out the intent, problem, solution and meta UML model with suitable example for  
  builder design pattern.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply Builder design pattern and draw solution in the form of UML diagram for the  
  scenario to convert a rich text format (RTF) document into different representations like (5)  
  Text, ACSII and HTML.  
  
  3)           List out the intent, problem, solution and meta UML model with suitable example for  
  facade design pattern.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply decorator design pattern for designing a notification library for third part  
  application with SMS, email and Facebook notifications.                                   (5)  
  
  4)           List out the intent, problem, solution and meta UML model with suitable example for  
  Template design pattern.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply and draw meta model of Iterator design pattern with suitable example.               (5)

  5)              Apply singleton design pattern for the following scenario:  
  Draw the solution in the form of UML diagram for the scenario for maintaining log  
  information of application which helps developer to check logs, errors, and debugging      (5)  
  A)         messages of applications.  
  
  B)         Apply Strategy design pattern for the following scenario:  
  Consider a scenario to sort the list of integers using three different algorithms such as  
  Quick sort, Insertion sort and Merge sort. Sort strategy can be selected optionally during (5)  
  run time based on time and space complexities. Draw solution in the form UML diagram  
  by applying strategy design pattern.
